description: Defines a partial struct 'Writer<TBufferWriter>' with methods for writing serialization tags related to object boundaries in a wire protocol, specifically for tag-delimited serialization.

classes.name: Writer<TBufferWriter>
classes.description: A partial generic struct used for writing serialized data buffers with methods for writing object boundary tags.

methods.name: WriteStartObject
methods.description: Writes the start object tag, including the field id and expected/actual types, using a specific wire type.

methods.name: WriteEndObject
methods.description: Writes the end object tag to signal completion of an object serialization.

methods.name: WriteEndBase
methods.description: Writes the end of base fields tag for serialization.
